system.description:
Marksmanship of the open country, the Red Waste, the plains and the Boldock Wall, built around long sightlines.

  • Long Sight: Running Shot's trigger is also met when the target is more than 60ft away, even if you have not moved.
    • 9th level: more than 30ft away.
  • Patient Tracker: Advantage on Survival checks to track a wounded creature you've shot.
